description: A build script that generates a README file by merging various markdown sources, processing frontmatter, updating links and images, and adding a table of contents. It orchestrates reading markdown files, transforming their ASTs, and writing the final combined document.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the process of appending markdown files, processing AST, and writing the final README.

methods.name: parseFrontmatter
methods.description: AST plugin to parse YAML frontmatter from markdown nodes.

methods.name: codeLanguageJsonToJsonc
methods.description: AST plugin to convert 'json' code blocks to 'jsonc'.

methods.name: rewritePageLinksToAnchorLinks
methods.description: AST plugin to convert page links to anchor links, adjusting URLs accordingly.

methods.name: rewriteImgTargets
methods.description: AST plugin to update image URLs to point to static assets.

methods.name: trimCutFromTwoslashCode
methods.description: AST plugin to trim code blocks with 'twoslash' meta, removing content above a special cut marker.

methods.name: headerNode
methods.description: Helper function to generate a markdown heading node with specified depth and text.
